body: Since its introduction, the Airbus A350 has been widely regarded as one of the leaders in twin-aisle cabin comfort. Its XWB tag stands for eXtra Wide Body, and Airbus designed a fuselage cross-section that gives good usable internal width, sidewall geometry and seating flexibility. The A350 has an internal cabin width of about 5.61 metres, about 18.4 feet, between wall panels, depending on how the measurement is taken, and most airlines use a 3-3-3 layout in economy class on the A350. Boeing's next-generation 777X is set to challenge that status: through sculpted sidewalls, thinner walls and insulation, and revised interior framing, Boeing has squeezed more usable cabin width while keeping the external fuselage largely similar to the classic 777 family.

Boeing claims that its new 777X cabin is four inches wider than the 777-300ER, and according to Runway Girl Network the 777X will offer about 5.97 metres, about 19.6 feet, of internal cabin width. The way the extra width is used will depend heavily on airline cabin choices: wider aisles, larger armrests, more shoulder room, or more seat width versus more seats per row. From data and mockups, Boeing has shown that in a ten-abreast economy layout the 777X can support about 18-inch seat widths in certain configurations, larger than some of the tighter ten-abreast layouts on the A350, which may reduce seat width to about 17 inches or less depending on the airline. For airlines seeking maximum capacity, they might still squeeze ten seats across in economy, but the 777X offers more flexibility to make that ten-abreast more comfortable than the equivalent ten-abreast in older 777s or even the A350.

Cabin width is only one axis of passenger comfort, and the A350 still has strong points. Cabin height, ceiling design, window placement and size, cabin altitude and humidity, noise suppression and air circulation all matter too, and the A350 offers larger overhead bins, high ceilings, lighting design and a composite fuselage. Airbus has also updated the A350 cabin through the New Passenger Standard variant, with improvements in cabin layout, weight and maximum takeoff weight that aim to slightly widen or at least make better use of cabin space, and it has been planning or implementing interior tweaks to allow ten-abreast seating in some configurations on the A350 NPS, though with a reduced seat width. The A350 is no longer assured of being the world's widest widebody, but comfort depends on far more than raw cabin width, and the true test will come once the 777X enters service and airlines reveal how they configure it.
en.summary: The Airbus A350 has long been praised for its twin-aisle cabin comfort, but Boeing's 777X is designed to offer about 5.97 metres of internal cabin width, compared with about 5.61 metres on the A350, reshaping how airlines and passengers judge widebody comfort.
en.title: The Airbus A350's days as the world's widest twinjet are numbered as the Boeing 777X promises a wider cabin

body: 空中巴士A350問世以來，長期被視為雙走道客艙舒適度的領先者之一。XWB代表eXtra Wide Body，空中巴士為其設計的機身截面帶來良好的可用內部寬度、側壁幾何形狀與座椅配置彈性。A350客艙內部寬度約5.61公尺（約18.4英尺），量測位置不同會略有差異，多數航空公司在A350經濟艙採3-3-3配置。波音新一代777X正要挑戰這個地位：透過塑形側壁、較薄的壁板與隔熱層以及重新設計的內裝框架，波音在外型機身大致維持與傳統777家族相同的情況下，擠出更多可用客艙寬度。

波音表示，新款777X客艙比777-300ER寬4英寸，據Runway Girl Network報導，777X客艙內部寬度將約5.97公尺（約19.6英尺）。多出來的寬度如何運用，很大程度取決於航空公司的客艙選擇：更寬的走道、更大的扶手、更多的肩部空間，或是座椅寬度與每排座位數之間的取捨。根據數據與模型，777X在10座並排的經濟艙配置中，特定布局可支援約18英寸的座椅寬度，大於A350部分較緊湊的10座並排布局，後者座椅寬度可能降至約17英寸或更窄，視航空公司而定。追求最大載客量的航空公司仍可能在經濟艙塞入10座並排，但777X讓這種10座並排比舊型777或A350的同等布局更舒適的彈性更大。

客艙寬度只是乘客舒適度的一個面向，A350仍有很強的優勢。客艙高度、天花板設計、窗戶位置與大小、座艙氣壓高度與濕度、噪音抑制與空氣循環都很重要，而A350具備較大的頭頂置物箱、高天花板、燈光設計與複合材料機身。空中巴士也透過New Passenger Standard改款更新A350客艙，在客艙布局、重量與最大起飛重量上改進，目標是略微加寬或至少更善用客艙空間，並已規劃或著手在部分布局的A350 NPS上導入10座並排座椅，只是座椅寬度會縮小。A350不再穩居全球最寬廣體客機，但舒適度遠不只看原始客艙寬度，真正的考驗要等777X投入營運、航空公司公布各自的配置後才會揭曉。
zh.summary: 空中巴士A350長期以雙走道客艙舒適度著稱，但波音777X的客艙內部寬度設計約5.97公尺，高於A350的約5.61公尺，正在改寫航空公司與乘客評斷廣體客機舒適度的方式。
zh.title: A350最寬雙發動機客機寶座將讓給777X：客艙寬度解析
